shadowSentences: The sky is very clear today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn with all the colors.
Traveling to new places can be very exciting.
Cooking new recipes is a fun way to spend the evening.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I find it interesting to learn about different cultures.
Exercising regularly is important for maintaining good health.
Spending time with friends can improve your mood and well-being.
Finding a balance between work and leisure is essential for happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your daily eating habits?
Q2: What challenges do you face in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: How do you think eating habits affect overall health?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies.
